messages:
Marta: quick check — prepping gpt-mpt50k onboarding. two asks: (1) where are the final fp32 weights? (2) tokenizer oddity on "<|newline|>" tokens causing extra spaces in evals. need sign-off for quant configs (AWQ vs GPTQ vs FP8) and calibration dataset size.

Samir: weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/gpt-mpt50k/v1/weights.tar.lz4. prod path will be the same after rename. I'm re-running hash but they're uploaded.

Alice: saw the tokenizer issue — tokenizer adds a soft-split when newline is followed by punctuation (".,?"). workaround in serving: post-tokenize join with `.replace(/\s+\n/,'\n')`. Not ideal but low risk.

Kevin: quick summary of quant experiments (short):
- AWQ 4-bit: latency 0.42x baseline, avg token latency 18ms, perplexity +1.7% vs fp32 on evalset-A, small drop on long-context QA (more hallucination).
- GPTQ 4-bit: latency 0.6x baseline, perp +0.9%, better stability on long docs.
- FP8 (e4m3): latency 0.5x baseline, perp +2.3%, but 2x throughput in batching.
Full logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/1876543000/quant_runs.zip

Marta: thanks — is calibration dataset size tuned? We tried calib=5% of train ~40k examples and calib=1% ~8k examples. Samir which one was used for AWQ run?

Samir: AWQ run used 8k calibration samples (random slices). GPTQ run used 40k. I can re-run AWQ with 40k but it'll add ~6h to pipeline.

Alice: accuracy tradeoff note: on our user eval set AWQ@8k shows +2% exact-match drop on retrieval QA but 0.5% on dialogue. GPTQ@40k keeps EM within 0.4% of fp32. FP8 at 40k still had the 2.3% overall perf gap.

Marta: okay so ops decision: do we accept AWQ@8k (faster and smaller) or require GPTQ@40k for parity? need approvals from eng-ml + infra. cc @kevin_ng @samir.patel

Kevin: my recommendation: canary AWQ@40k to get the stability benefits without full GPTQ compute cost, but run evals for hallucination-prone prompts. If we see regression >1% EM on critical prompts, rollback to GPTQ.

Samir: I can schedule AWQ@40k run tonight. I also propose adding a prefix KV-cache test to the calibration set to catch sequential corruption cases (tokenizer-newline related).

Marta: good call. for rollout plan:
1) AWQ@40k build in staging with tokenizer fix patch applied.
2) Run eval suite + bias/regression checks (2k prompts in canary list).
3) Canary to 5% traffic for 24h with canary alert on EM drop >1% or latency P95 >200ms.
4) If green, ramp to 50% then 100% with 1h waits.

Alice: added a small CI job to validate tokenizer patch on tokenized outputs (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/428). ci-bot will run the quant builds once merged.

ci-bot: CI queued for models/pr/428. steps: unit -> tokenizer-tests -> quant-build. ETA ~1h.

Ops-oncall: heads-up — I'll reserve 2x gpus on dedicated pool for the AWQ@40k run and watch canary. leave a note in incidents channel if we need rollback.

Samir: started AWQ@40k job: job-id qrun-1876543240. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/qrun-1876543240/logs (running).

Marta: ping me when job completes and paste eval summary. Also please attach the small set of failure prompts if any so PM can triage.

Kevin: one more request from security: FP8 path needs explicit approval for HSM key access during model compilation. @security please confirm HSM policy covers this.

Marta: tagging @kevin_ng for final go/no-go. I need at least two approvals (eng-ml + infra). Reaction OKs or explicit "sg" please. :thumbsup:

Samir: sg from infra.

Alice: sg from tokenization/qa.

Kevin: sg from perf. starting canary once job finishes.

ci-bot: job qrun-1876543240 completed — artifacts uploaded. eval summary: AWQ@40k vs fp32: EM -0.8%, Rouge-L -0.6%, latency P95 -48%. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/qrun-1876543240/

Marta: perfect — rolling canary now (5%). will update incidents if anything odd. thanks team :rocket:
